state.name: Minnesota
state.blurb: Chimcare serves Minnesota homeowners through 14 branch points across the Twin Cities metro.
state.heroLede: We're in Minneapolis and St. Paul themselves, and in the communities around them on every side — Maple Grove and Brooklyn Center to the north, Wayzata, St. Louis Park, Edina, and Eden Prairie on the west metro, Eagan, Apple Valley, and Lakeville to the south, and Maplewood and Lake Elmo out east. Wherever you are in the metro, there's a Chimcare team working close to your neighborhood.
introParagraphs: We're a family-owned company that has been doing this work since 1989, and our technicians are certified chimney professionals. In Minnesota, the two services homeowners book most are chimney sweeping and chimney inspection — and the reasons are practical ones. A heating season here can run from October into April, so a fireplace or wood stove burns far more hours than it would in a milder state, and creosote builds up in the flue accordingly. The freeze-thaw swings of spring and fall are also hard on masonry: moisture works into small gaps in a chimney crown or mortar joint, freezes, expands, and slowly widens them. Left alone for a few seasons, a minor gap becomes a repair job. Caught early, it usually isn't.

That's why a {{price.inspection}} chimney inspection before the burning season is a sensible habit for a Minnesota home, especially in the older neighborhoods of Minneapolis and St. Paul where original masonry chimneys are now many decades old. For homes with gas fireplaces — common across the newer suburbs — we offer a {{price.gas_diagnostic}} gas fireplace diagnostic, and for repair or masonry work we'll put a written quote in your hands with no obligation attached.

Find your city below to see the Chimcare branch nearest you, what neighbors there typically book, and how to request service. If your town isn't listed, choose the closest one — our service areas overlap, and the team there can tell you right away whether they cover your address.
